# Vienna Life Assistant

> Personal life management webapp + MCP server for Vienna life admin.

## Docs
- [Full reference](llms-full.txt)
- [Install guide](INSTALL.md)
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)

## Quick start
```powershell
Set-Location web_sota
.\start.ps1
```

| Surface | Port |
|---------|------|
| Frontend | 10988 |
| Backend + MCP | 10922 |

## Key files
- `web_sota/vienna_life_assistant/server.py` — FastAPI + FastMCP
- `web_sota/vienna_life_assistant/vienna_life_mcp.py` — portmanteau MCP tools
- `web_sota/vienna_life_assistant/skills/` — 6 skill bundles
- `web_sota/src/pages/` — 16 frontend pages
- `native/` — Tauri 2.0 NSIS wrapper
